_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 7 — bản tiếng Anh của thanso_do_thi.json (đồ thị liên phái). Ban biên tập viết, chờ người bản xứ duyệt.

source.ten: Hieuban editorial reference text (2026) comparing the Pythagorean and Chaldean schools of numerology
source.luu_y: Draft written with AI assistance, shown by decision of the project owner. A cultural reference, not a forecast.

ten_day_du.ten: How you express yourself (from your full name)

linh_hon.ten: What is inside (the vowels of your name)

nhan_cach.ten: The outer impression (the consonants of your name)

cong_huong.cach_doc: When it comes to {nhom}, both schools arrive at {so} ({tu_khoa}). Different methods pointing to the same trait — this is the first place worth checking against yourself.
cong_huong.goi_y: Read the shadow side of {so} carefully: the stronger a trait, the more easily its shadow shows.

khac_nhip.cach_doc: When it comes to {nhom}, each school arrives at a different number: {danh_sach}. Neither is wrong — each letter table looks at your name from its own angle.
khac_nhip.goi_y: Read these numbers and keep what you see in your actual behaviour; skip whatever does not fit.

bo_sung.cach_doc: {nhom}: the Pythagorean school sees karmic debt {so_a}, the Chaldean school sees compound number {so_b}. {cach_dung}

nhip_thoi_gian.cach_doc: {nam} is a Personal Year {so} — the same as your most prominent number ({tu_khoa}). A chance to watch this trait in your everyday life.
nhip_thoi_gian.goi_y: Use this year to practise the strong side of {so} and keep an eye on its shadow side.

quy_tac_dien_dat.noi_dung: Use everyday language and familiar images; any technical term needs a short explanation.
Do not make pronouncements about the future; never use "you will", "certainly", "destiny".
Every positive trait comes with its shadow side and a question for self-reflection.
Use only the numbers and meanings in this package; do not add years, dates or events.
When the schools give different numbers, present them as two angles, without picking the right one.
